name: Anomaly Transformer精简结构复现
implementation: two association-attention layers, learned Gaussian prior, series/prior minimax discrepancy, reconstruction-weighted anomaly score; compact reproduction, not authors checkpoint
source: real Volve per-well production windows; controlled perturbations only for labeled evaluation

split.policy: chronological split; no window crosses split; scaler/imputer fit training only; validation reconstruction selects checkpoint and controlled labels select threshold

limitations: Compact trained structural reproduction rather than authors official checkpoint.
Precision/recall/AUC refer only to controlled constructed perturbations. Unmodified real windows are not expert-confirmed normal.
Frozen held-out outputs; no live browser Torch inference.
Natural production event detection cannot establish root cause or treatment effects.
Controlled shifts retain nonnegative production and bounded water-cut; still not independently confirmed field events.
Windows contain 32 source records and may span calendar gaps. Natural input gaps use train-only median and are flagged in source_observed_mask.
